# jamesbrady.org — James Brady

> Founder and AI systems builder. Products, agents, workflows, and proof systems that turn AI capability into accountable work.

## Pages

- / — The Of One operating thesis, selected proof, current systems work, open library, and direct inquiry form.
- /about — James Brady's operating perspective, principles, current work, and canonical social profiles.
- /contact — Direct project, partnership, speaking, and media inquiries routed through the Utlyze lead system.
- /watch — Narrated system stories and practical walkthroughs with written summaries.
- /primer — Code, the stack, AI agents, skills, and MCP explained for humans.
- /manuscript — A curated catalog of tools and frameworks used in the practice.
- /workshop — Practical guides for setting up an agent, installing skills, and connecting MCP servers.

## Machine-readable endpoints

- /api/catalog — JSON catalog of tools with descriptions and source links.

- /.well-known/ai-manifest.json — Site structure and capabilities.

AI-native products, agent architecture, human-and-AI workflows, Model Context Protocol, durable context, verification, operating systems, and evidence-backed execution.
